assumptions: Agent-assisted authored draft; annotation_origin=agent_assisted_draft; needs_human_review=true. No independent human validation is claimed.
All 128 cases are fresh scoring material: eight novel wording/entity groups per evidence channel and all eight world/access/record combinations per group.
The channels share the same binary gold function. This is evidence-channel transfer with new wording, not broad reasoning-family OOD.
The world ends opposite its initial state in each authored scene. This is an authoring invariant, not a public rule available to an absent reader.
Both people observe the initial placement together, and the sender observes the entire world transfer without seeing the reader's private access.
In observation_prior, reader_updated means the reader actually watches the transfer; sender_recorded means the trusted attendance entry says so.

In trusted_message_update, the reader always misses the world transfer and the sender knows this. reader_updated means private receipt/read/trust of the truthful current-location note; sender_recorded is the independently varied receipt accepted by the sender.

The actual delivery can fail despite a positive trusted receipt, or succeed despite a negative trusted receipt. The sender has no independent view of the reader or their inbox. Possible receipt errors are narrator-only information.
The reader remembers the last observed location and updates after observing a transfer or reading a trusted current-location note. There are no other updates.

Base labels encode location content for place_b, not accuracy of a person's belief. The reader and nested labels equal world if their respective access bit is one, and otherwise equal the initial location.
For each target, place_a and place_b candidate labels are exact complements. Candidate claims name a location only and do not name a perspective or give gold.
Each sender candidate prefix is byte-identical across actual-access pairs; actual hidden reader labels are therefore structurally unknowable in that view.
SYSTEM, neutral candidate disclaimer, and perspective-question stems match the legacy task. Questions are separate metadata and are not in candidate prefixes.
Actor-role assignment is fixed within each complete cube and independent of source bits; initial reader-first/sender-first mention order is balanced across groups.

All groups have new people and places, including between the two channels. Channel comparisons therefore also include fresh lexical variation and are not an isolated causal effect of the evidence operation.
Pairwise score subtraction does not prove causal belief tracking, remove every candidate interaction, or validate an unknown-future-message forecast.

candidates.claim: The token is in the oak chest.

omniscient.content: Read the fictional scene. Questions will follow. Each person has only the observations and messages explicitly available to them. People remember the last place they observed the token and update after seeing a move or receiving a trusted message about its current place. They do not infer an unobserved move. Narrator-only information is not shared with a character merely because the narrator describes it.

At 16:00, Aiden and Bea jointly inspect a token as it is stored in the pine chest.

At 16:10 the custodian takes the token from the pine chest to the oak chest. Bea sees the full transfer on an object-only video feed. The feed cannot show Aiden or whether Aiden watches it. The token is not moved again.

Private attendance, unavailable to Bea: Aiden is elsewhere for the entire 16:10 transfer and sees none of it. Aiden receives no update and does not learn that a transfer occurred. Bea has no independent way to see this attendance.

Attendance record available to Bea: The attendance entry says Aiden did not watch any of the 16:10 transfer. It records no later token-location update to Aiden. Bea accepts that particular entry as accurate and has no other attendance information. No token-location messages are exchanged.

The scene ends at 16:20. After the stated events, there are no additional token observations, contacts, or updates.

Candidate statement for later assessment, not a new observation or message to either person: "The token is in the oak chest."

The scene is complete. Questions follow.
